description:
FILED s470bt (Opus, 2026-09-06) by the B6 IR conformance corpus (4 cases).
Three separate bugs in one family; split when scheduled.  (The NESTED-ELEMENT
`local` spellings are #1190 and are listed there, not here.)

PROBES (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL main cd34df72):

(a) `local(LIST) = LIST` is a LIST assignment
      sub f { local($H) = @_; return "H=$H" }
      print f("beach"), "\n";
    perl  H=beach          PCL  H=1
    -- PCL assigns in SCALAR context, so $H gets the argument COUNT.  This is
    the classic pre-`my` idiom, so it is everywhere in old code (the corpus
    case 145-local is a real fragment from one).

(b) `local` inside a call's ARGUMENT LIST is never restored
      our $g = "outer";
      sub show { print "g=$g\n" }
      sub wrap { my ($v,$d) = @_; show(); }
      sub inner { wrap((local $g = "inner"), "arg"); }
      inner(); show();
    perl  g=inner / g=outer      PCL  g=inner / g=inner
    -- the save is never popped, so the change escapes the sub.

(c) the SYMBOLIC spelling does not set
      no strict 'refs'; our $g = 1;
      { local ${'main::g'} = 9; print ${'main::g'}, "\n" }
    perl  9        PCL  (empty)
    -- `local ${'NAME'}` localises something, but the assignment lands
    nowhere; the read inside the scope is empty.

CORPUS CASES: 133-local (c) 136-local (b) 137-local (b) 145-local (a).


=== s473a (2026-09-07, Opus): (a) and (c) SHIPPED, (b) NOT â the task stays
=== open for (b) ===
 (a) `local($X) = LIST` is a LIST assignment â commit 071a0de4.  The parens
     were being dropped when _process_local_declaration built its own @items;
     the flip is narrowed to SCALAR targets, because an array or hash lvalue
     imposes list context on its own AND keeping them on the solo path is what
     preserves `local (@bim) = local(@bee) = LIST` (min_local.t:18).
     ir-conform 145-local left known-fail.tsv.  Residue #1339: the SUBSCRIPTED
     spelling `local($a[1]) = (7,8)`, whose general fix costs the
     p-local-*-elem-init fast path (0.93 s -> 1.14 s, measured).
 (c) = #1260 â commit 5461cf87, CLOSED.  Residue #1341: the subscripted
     symbolic deref.
 (b) = #1192 â NOT attempted: it needs a hoisting PRE-PASS (new mechanism).
     #1192 now carries the full measurement and design: perl restores at the
     end of the enclosing BLOCK (probed), there are TWO PPI shapes, and the
     pre-pass must not hoist a `local` out of a nested Structure::Block.
     ir-conform 136-local and 137-local are still listed.
subject: THREE `local` divergences found by the ir-conform corpus: `local($X) = LIST` assigns a SCALAR (the count), `local $g` inside a call ARGUMENT LIST is never restored, and `local ${'main::g'}` (symbolic) never sets the value
